line: *(Appended under the author's ruling `(R206)`(4)(c), 2026-10-02, b596, through the node list's backmatter record.)* The faces and multiplicity: `h2_sign_iff_rh` (SIDE-explicit-formula v0.2 = `5c72cad`), `li_nonneg_iff_rh` and `arith_limit_nonneg_iff_rh` (v0.9 = `e5a5a83`) each state an equivalence with Mathlib's `RiemannHypothesis`, whose statement names no multiplicity; the sum over the zeros behind each face carries `Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig.mult` as a weight (the zero side that `b321_identity` equates with `h2_sign`'s arithmetic side; `LiCoeff`; the arithmetic limit, through `li_identity_sym`); so multiplicity is carried as weight by each face and constrained by none. At the schema's form, a configuration whose fields, target and Weil positivity all hold has a point of multiplicity two (`SIDEExplicitFormula.Simplicity.SaltCheck.allSimple_not_forced`, v0.17), and `SIDEExplicitFormula.Simplicity.simplicity` stands beside the faces as its own Prop.
